title: General Muellner's retirement-day interview on Aurora

tellings.quote: with a guy called General George Moina who was the US Air Force's head of research and development until his retirement in 1998.

plain: On the day he retired in 1998, General George Muellner, "the US Air Force's head of research and development," sat for an interview about Aurora, the name given to a rumoured secret American aircraft. The writer Nick Cook tells Michels he did that interview himself, for a documentary called Billion Dollar Secret. Cook brings it up as a rare chance to put questions about secret aircraft to the man who had run Air Force research.
